narrative.overview:
A near-black page (night) lit from behind by a hand-written WebGL fragment shader: a slowly drifting fbm height map drawn as thin topographic contour lines (every fifth line brighter), moonlight in the valleys and ember on the peaks, rising into a hill under the pointer and glowing where it rests. Everything on top is type. One variable face, Archivo, set very light (260–320) and wide (108–115%) at display sizes, so the letters read as lit edges rather than ink. The only colors besides bone-white text are the two lights the field itself emits, ember and moonlight, plus a single mint status dot on live projects.

The field is atmosphere, not decoration under the words: text blocks marked as calm zones push the shader down to 7% in a soft-edged rectangle around them, the field dims as the hero scrolls away, and it brightens again toward the contact section. Motion is filmic and slow (quint ease-out, 1000–1500 ms reveals) and always settles: kinetic letters, tilted project windows and the cursor spotlights return to rest when the pointer and scroll stop. Every effect has a static path for `prefers-reduced-motion` and a content-complete no-JS path.

Internally this is v6b. Other generations stay linked from the footer: v4 at `/old/`, v5.1 "modrotisk" blueprint at `/v5/`, and v6a at `/v6a/` (this same system with a domain-warped filament shader instead of contour lines). The hero carries no meta row (no location, coordinates or availability badge); the name stands alone under the header.
keyCharacteristics: Dark base (night) with a live WebGL light field fixed behind the page; a 6% SVG noise grain sits over everything.
One typeface, Archivo variable (wght 100–900, wdth 62–125%); hierarchy through weight, width and size, never a second family.
Display type light (260–320) with tight negative tracking; kinetic headings modulate width and weight per letter.
Two light accents, ember (warm) and moonlight (cool); mint only for "live" status.
Rounded glass containers (14–20px) against 1px hairline rules; no hard boxes.
Shared single `styles.css`, `main.js`, `kinetic-lite.js` across CS and EN.

rules.name: The Lights Not Paint Rule
rules.body: Ember and moonlight appear only as small emissive things: dots, numerals, single words, 1–2px lines, glows and spotlights. No accent-filled buttons, panels or section backgrounds.

rules.name: The Two Lights Rule
rules.body: Every gradient line pairs moonlight and ember (HUD progress bar, timeline progress, contact e-mail underline). No third hue enters a gradient.

rules.name: The Translucent Night Rule
rules.body: Surfaces over the field are translucent night (0.75–0.85 alpha), never opaque, so the light behind stays readable as one continuous space.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo only. Hierarchy comes from weight (260–500), width (108–115% on display roles) and size. No mono, no serif, no second sans.

rules.name: The Light Display Rule
rules.body: Anything above 26px sits at weight 260–380 with negative tracking (-0.015em to -0.05em). Heavier display weight exists only transiently, as kinetic response (+80 at most).

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase and no letter-spaced labels anywhere; meta reads as quiet sentence-case text in bone-muted.

rules.name: The Calm Under Text Rule
rules.body: Every non-heading text block over the open field carries `data-calm`; the shader reduces itself to 7% within a soft margin (18px pad, 2–14% of viewport height falloff) around it. Up to 8 zones. Headings are allowed to sit in the light; paragraphs are not.

rules.name: The Field Breathes With Story Rule
rules.body: Field intensity is tied to position: full in the hero, down to 28% after it, rising back toward 76% as the contact section enters.

dos: Do mark every paragraph-level text block placed over the open field with `data-calm` (max 8 per page).
Do keep display type at weight 260–320 with width 108–115% and tracking between -0.03em and -0.05em.
Do use ember and moonlight only as light: dots, numerals, single words, 1–2px lines, glows and spotlights.
Do run every gradient line between moonlight and ember.
Do frame project screenshots in the browser window, captured at the same 1440x900 viewport, and tint each window's `--glow` from the project's own color.
Do use the quint ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)) for reveals and 600–1500ms durations for entrances; 200–300ms for state color changes.
Do give every motion a settled rest state and a reduced-motion path where all content is visible and static.
Do keep the version switcher in both language footers whenever a generation is archived.
donts: Don't add a second typeface, uppercase labels or letter-spaced captions.
Don't fill buttons, panels or sections with ember, moonlight or mint.
Don't make surfaces over the field opaque; use translucent night at 0.75–0.85 alpha.
Don't add dark drop shadows to anything other than project windows; depth elsewhere comes from glass, light glows and the field.
Don't let kinetic or tilt effects keep moving once pointer and scroll are idle.
Don't use mint for anything other than live project status.
